name: keysi
title: Keysi
description: Search the keyboard shortcuts of the app you're in, and the cheat sheets for tools that have no menu bar at all.
author: noloman

commands.name: search-sheets
commands.title: Search Cheat Sheets
commands.subtitle: Keysi
commands.description: Search Vim, tmux and your own cheat sheets without leaving the keyboard.

commands.name: show-shortcuts
commands.title: Show Shortcuts
commands.subtitle: Keysi
commands.description: Open Keysi's panel for the app you were just in.

commands.name: practice
commands.title: Practice Shortcuts
commands.subtitle: Keysi
commands.description: Open Keysi's drill for the shortcuts you keep missing.

commands.name: progress
commands.title: Show Progress
commands.subtitle: Keysi
commands.description: Open Keysi's recap of the shortcuts you've learned.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

preferences.name: keysiApp
preferences.title: Keysi Application
preferences.description: Where Keysi is installed. Only needed if it isn't in /Applications or ~/Applications — the bundled cheat sheets are read out of the app bundle.
